nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Houston. One o'clock our time. Tulane has won four games and lost five. Rice has won one game and lost eight. Tulane needs to win two of its last three games to reach a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulane's coach liked what he saw at Tuesday's practice
news.summary: Will Hall talked to reporters after a closed practice Tuesday and said the team had a great day and that his players want to prove themselves. He said the Tulsa loss falls on him, and that Rice, up next on Saturday, has two fast quarterbacks who like to run.

news.headline: Tulane's coach takes the blame for the 60-10 loss
news.summary: Will Hall said the loss to Tulsa starts with him and that Tulane did not do anything well. He also said punter William Hudlow hurt a finger in the game and that he hopes to have him back this week.

news.headline: Tulsa routs Tulane 60-10 at Homecoming
news.summary: Tulsa led 32-0 at halftime and Tulane never got going, losing by 50 points in front of the Homecoming crowd at Yulman Stadium. It is the worst conference loss Tulane has ever had, and the Green Wave are now four wins and five losses.

nextGame.note: Saturday evening road game in Lexington, Kentucky. A quarter past five our time. Florida has won five games and lost four and needs one more win to reach a bowl game. Kentucky has won seven games and lost two.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will start at quarterback for Florida
news.summary: ESPN reported Thursday that Florida is going back to Philo to start Saturday night at Kentucky. Tramell Jones started last week against Oklahoma and threw two interceptions in the 23-7 loss.

news.headline: Florida lands a big offensive lineman for 2027
news.summary: Moreno Fisher, a 6-foot-7, 305-pound tackle from Charlotte, North Carolina, said Thursday he is coming to Florida. He had promised to go to Virginia back in June, then changed his mind last month and visited Gainesville the weekend before he picked the Gators.

news.headline: Ty Jackson earns a starting job at Florida
news.summary: Jackson barely played on defense for a season and a half, then blocked a punt against South Carolina and started getting more snaps. He made his first start against Oklahoma, and Coach Jon Sumrall has pointed to him as a player who keeps fighting.

nextGame.note: Saturday night road game in Baton Rouge, about an hour up the road. Half past six our time. Texas has won seven games and lost two. LSU has won six and lost three.

news.headline: Texas gets two starters back for the LSU game
news.summary: Receiver Cam Coleman and defensive end Colin Simmons were both left off the conference injury report this week, so they can play Saturday night in Baton Rouge. Four Longhorns are out, including running back Hollywood Smothers and left tackle Trevor Goosby.

news.headline: LSU's coach has kind words for Arch Manning
news.summary: Lane Kiffin tried to get Manning to come to Ole Miss when Manning was in high school, and lost him to Texas. Talking to reporters this week before Saturday's game, Kiffin called him a great kid and said he hopes he does well, other than on Saturday.

news.headline: Arch Manning is still up for a national award
news.summary: Manning was one of 30 quarterbacks named Tuesday to this year's class for the Davey O'Brien Award, which goes to the best quarterback in the country. The list gets cut down next Tuesday and the winner is announced December 11.

nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Carolina. Noon our time. The Saints and Carolina both have three wins and five losses, so whoever wins this one is alone in first place in their division.

news.headline: Erik McCoy is out Sunday and Kamara is ready to go
news.summary: The Saints ruled center Erik McCoy out of Sunday's game on Friday because of his hurt biceps, so Cesar Ruiz will play center against Carolina. Alvin Kamara practiced fully Thursday and Friday and is good to go, and running back Travis Etienne is a maybe with a sore hamstring.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara was back at practice Thursday
news.summary: Kamara rested his back and sat out Wednesday, then practiced fully on Thursday. Center Erik McCoy, who hurt his biceps on Sunday, has not practiced at all this week, so Cesar Ruiz will play center against Carolina.

news.headline: Saints pick their team doctor for a military award
news.summary: The Saints named head team orthopedist Dr. Stephen Choate as their nominee for the NFL's Salute to Service Award. He spent four years in the Air Force, rose to the rank of major, and has been the team's doctor for nine seasons.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon semifinal at home. Half past two our time, half past three theirs. IUP plays Clarion and has already beaten Clarion twice this season, 3-2 in September and 3-1 in October. The match is across campus at the Kovalchick Complex, not at Memorial Field House. Every IUP volleyball game is on the free PSAC Sports Digital Network app, and it costs nothing to watch. Tap the link above on game day and the match comes right up. You can also search PSAC on a phone, an Apple TV or a Fire TV, or open psacsportsdigitalnetwork.com/iupathletics in a browser. Gannon plays Seton Hill in the other semifinal, and the two winners meet for the conference title here on Sunday. The time for Sunday has not been posted yet. IUP's schedule also lists the national tournament the week after, November 19 to 21.

news.headline: IUP sweeps East Stroudsburg to reach the semifinals
news.summary: IUP won in three straight sets at home Wednesday night, 25-12, 25-16 and 26-24. Delaney Concannon had 17 kills, the Crimson Hawks are 22 wins and 5 losses, and they play again Saturday.

news.headline: IUP's coach and three players win conference honors
news.summary: The conference named IUP coach Avery Moore the best coach in the West on Wednesday, the first time she has won it. Delaney Concannon and Jessica Neiman made the all-conference first team and Charlotte Potvin made the second team.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

news.headline: The Yankees lose their bench coach to Houston
news.summary: Brad Ausmus sat next to Aaron Boone in the Yankees dugout for the last three seasons, and on Wednesday the Astros hired him to be their manager. He managed the Tigers for four years and the Angels for one before coming to New York.

news.headline: Cam Schlittler wins the Cy Young Award
news.summary: The Yankees right-hander was named the best pitcher in the American League on Wednesday, and all 30 voters put him first. He won 14 games and lost 6, gave up 1.95 runs a game and struck out 239 batters.

news.headline: Max Fried had surgery on his pitching elbow
news.summary: General manager Brian Cashman said Tuesday that a small piece of bone was taken out of the left-hander's elbow. The ligament was not touched, and Fried should start throwing again in December and be ready when spring training opens.

nextGame.note: First round of the state playoffs on Friday night, on the road in Shreveport. Kickoff is seven o'clock. That is a long drive, about five hours from New Orleans. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and Evangel is the 12th. Evangel has won six games and lost four.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.

news.headline: John Ehret beats Warren Easton 35-18
news.summary: Warren Easton lost Thursday night in Marrero. It was the Eagles' first district loss and it ended a four-game winning streak, and it drops them from first place in the district to third.
